name: Benign resource-based statement without Resource (must NOT be flagged)
note: S1-shape-failclosed no-over-fire control. A resource-based / trust statement (Principal present) legitimately OMITS Resource - the resource is the attaching resource itself and is implied. UNSPECIFIED_RESOURCE_SCOPE must fire ONLY on identity-style statements (no Principal/NotPrincipal); a Principal-bearing statement is exempt. This fixture pins that the fail-closed resource-scope guard does not over-fire on the entire resource-policy family.
